# CodeLove Video Maker (videomaker.codelove.in)

> Free AI video maker that runs in the browser. Type a script and get a talking cartoon video — 66 characters with AI voices (Google Gemini, the visitor's own free key), lip sync, word-by-word subtitles, background music and sound effects — or a text-only video with big captions on a plain screen. Tamil, Tanglish, Telugu, Hindi, Hinglish and English. MP4 export for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and YouTube up to 4K. No sign-up, no watermark.

## Pages
- [Video Maker home](https://videomaker.codelove.in/): What it does, the cast, languages, how it works, FAQ.
- [Video Maker editor](https://videomaker.codelove.in/editor/): The free online editor — script, cast & voices, scene, captions, audio, export.

## Key facts
- Free to use, no account, no watermark.
- Voices and the optional AI script writer use Google Gemini through the user's own free API key, stored only in their browser.
- Two video types: "With characters" (cartoon people act the lines with lip sync) and "Text only" (captions on a plain colour screen).
- Formats: 9:16, 16:9, 1:1; 720p to 4K; 30 or 60 fps; subtitles also export as .srt.
- Finished videos can be sent straight to UTubeFlow (free YouTube scheduler).
